name: Symmachean Stalwarts
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee infantry · shields · 240 leadership · Seasonal (Legacy of Fire)
pitch: Stalwarts are the ultimate defensive anchor with near-unbreakable frontal hold and exceptional dueling power, dominating blob fights and skirmishes through perfect brace timing and cooldown resets. Vulnerable from behind and weak against heavy block-break units like Claymore with Linebreaker, they demand disciplined positioning and map awareness.

doctrines.name: Awareness Doctrine V
doctrines.note: −500 cav charge / −20% rear; situational vs divers + cav flank + reapers diving in

doctrines.name: Noble Blood Doctrine I
doctrines.note: only effective vs vipers / AOE comps

doctrines.name: Epic Spear Doctrine II (+250 block + 100% regen)

veterancy.label: Middle
veterancy.body: Middle for +1 target, then rest top — optimal for most engagements.

battleRole.positioning: Stalwarts are invincible from the front {2} and excel as the frontline shield-wall anchor. Position them to hold chokepoints and block ranged fire. Never advance into open space without map control — they are utterly vulnerable from behind {2}.
battleRole.formation: Use F3 formation to move, then transition to F2 and insta-brace — this stacks the Stalwart unit tightly for much higher damage; bracing with F2 only, the back-row Stalwart is otherwise wasted, and this tech fixes that {1}.
battleRole.tips: X-move in and brace, stay braced and X-move again or use Advance and re-brace every time brace cooldown is up {1}. CCi (Stand Fast) is your reset button — pop it vs polearm ultying you, enemy Imperial Pike, cavalry charge, or any CC {1}. Never V (retreat) with Stalwart, only brace {1}.

cards.name: Claymore & Reapers (with Linebreaker)
cards.why: heavy block-break units that overcome Stalwart defenses

cards.name: Cavalry
cards.why: Any charge from behind can kill Stalwarts; front-charge also brutal {3}

cards.name: All ranged and melee units
cards.why: Stalwarts counter everything with good CCi doctrine timing {1}

controls.notes: Core loop: X-move in or advance, brace (1), repeat. {1} CCi (Stand Fast) resets both your block bar and any CC on you — pop it vs polearm ultimate, enemy Imperial Pike, or cavalry charge. {1} Master the brace-timing rhythm: brace is your everything — never use V (retreat only brace), stay braced, and re-brace every time the cooldown is up. {1} CCi is mandatory in every build (resets block AND breaks CC). {1} A LOT of viable doctrine combos exist; personal pick is 1x Unit Damage V + full block stack. {1}

gaps: Video-transcript content is from 2021–2026; pre-patch (2021) ratings may not reflect current-season tuning; post-patch (Jun 2026) sources indicate hitbox-only nerfs (−12% brace, −18% stab) with no doctrine change.
